description: Be proactive in your life , because it belongs to you 🥂 #advocateforyourself #proactive #fyp
transcript: It is so important to be proactive because it is so easy to be sad. The hardest thing to be is happy because it requires so many sacrifices. Happiness requires discomfort. Happiness requires removing everything that you thought that you knew and looking at it different. Happiness requires you to challenge yourself, to challenge your morals, to challenge your values, thoughts, and ideas. You have to be proactive.
